summary: Institutional positioning is aggressively bullish, characterized by massive call buying across indices and semiconductors, evidenced by extremely low Put/Call ratios (e.g., SPXW at 0.12 and AMD at 0.10). Significant directional conviction is seen in massive long-dated call accumulations, specifically the $610.8M SPX 6000C (2026) and $401M AMD 320C (2026) trades. Persistent institutional interest is anchored by multi-day accumulation in the SPX 6000C (exp 2026-05-15) totaling $3.25B and SPXW 8120C (exp 2026-12-31) totaling $2.23B. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in the semiconductor sector (AMD, MU, NVDA) and monitor if the SPX 6000 level acts as a magnet for further premium expansion.
